moments.title: You don't need large amounts — you need to give your money time
moments.summary: The facilitator reads the compounding chart to a teens session: growth is exponential the longer you stay invested, so every year matters and you do not need to start with large amounts to build a large corpus.
moments.evidence: So every year matters and you don't need to start with large amounts of money to build large corpses. You just need to give your money time.

moments.title: Why your parents sent you to this class early
moments.summary: She tells the teenagers this is why their parents wanted them in the class now: the earlier you start, the longer your money's growth potential runs.
moments.evidence: Which is why today your parents really wanted you to do this class early because the earlier you start the longer your money's growth potential is.
